method_note: Blue Byte acquisition by Ubisoft is strong corporate evidence, but titles merely published by Blue Byte are not automatically assigned to Ubisoft. Title-specific code/art/music/trademark rights remain separate.
key_findings: Ubisoft's acquisition of Blue Byte establishes a strong successor route for core Blue Byte-owned IP.
Battle Isle and The Settlers are actively exploited Ubisoft IP and remain Class D.
Regional title aliases such as Pro Tennis Tour 2 / Great Courts 2 require release/hash verification before records are merged.
Blue Byte publishing credit alone is insufficient to establish ownership for titles developed or owned by third parties.
